name: Ananias
bio: Ananias, the high priest, presided over the council before which Paul was brought and ordered him struck on the mouth when Paul claimed a clear conscience; Paul, not recognizing him as high priest, rebuked him as a "whited wall" for judging contrary to the law, then apologized for not knowing his office (Acts 23:1-5). He is a different figure from Ananias of Damascus and Ananias the husband of Sapphira. He later came down to Caesarea to press charges against Paul before Felix (Acts 24:1). He brought the orator Tertullus to accuse Paul before Felix, but could not prove the charges (Acts 24:1-9).
